# dvllm

**Verifiable, delegated LLM inference in C++.**

`dvllm` splits transformer inference between two parties:

- A **server** (the *prover*) that holds the large fixed-point weights and performs
  all the expensive matrix multiplications — optionally on an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA).
- A **client** (the *verifier*) that runs the cheap parts of the network
  (embeddings, RMSNorm, RoPE, attention softmax, sampling) locally and
  **cryptographically verifies** every matmul the server returns, using a Matrix
  Commitment Scheme (MCS) over the `secp256k1` curve.

The result: you can offload the heavy compute of a model you don't fully trust,
and still be confident the returned activations were computed against the exact
committed weights — no blind trust in the remote box.

The lineage traces back to Karpathy's [`llama2.c`](https://github.com/karpathy/llama2.c)
and Dylan Harden's [`llama3.2.c`](https://github.com/Dylan-Harden3/llama3.2.c), but
this repo adds fixed-point quantization, a client/server split, GPU backends, and the
commitment-based verification layer.

__AI notice__: README was generated by AI, but corrected and verified for accuracy. For the development of the actual source, AI was used for catching bugs and supporting additional models, starting from a baseline human-written implementation.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20 FATAL_ERROR)
project(dvllm LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -march=native")
set(CMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES "gfx1102")
set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES "native")
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(ENABLE_EXTRAS OFF CACHE BOOL "Enable extra binaries in extras/ folder")
set(DISABLE_APPLE_METAL ON CACHE BOOL "Disable Apple Metal backend")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")

add_subdirectory(ext/simdcrypt)

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
  Corrosion
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion.git
  GIT_TAG v0.6.0)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Corrosion)

corrosion_import_crate(MANIFEST_PATH Cargo.toml CRATES mcs-cpp)

# add include directories
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

if(NOT DEFINED HIP_PATH)
    if(NOT DEFINED ENV{HIP_PATH})
        set(HIP_PATH "/opt/rocm/hip" CACHE PATH "Path to which HIP has been installed")
    else()
